CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS changes (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        old_content TEXT,
        new_content TEXT,
        diff TEXT,
        content_hash TEXT,
        lines_added INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        lines_removed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        batch_id TEXT,
        operation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'edit',
        rollback_to_id INTEGER,
        covered_by_rollback_id INTEGER,
        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_file_path ON changes(file_path)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_timestamp ON changes(timestamp)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_created_at ON changes(created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_batch_id ON changes(batch_id)
ALTER TABLE changes ADD COLUMN operation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'edit'
ALTER TABLE changes ADD COLUMN rollback_to_id INTEGER
ALTER TABLE changes ADD COLUMN covered_by_rollback_id INTEGER
